lines.en: Drift past you lightly.
I always float in the air.
Drift around while searching for food.
Drift towards the distant village.
Drift over fields and forests.
Drift towards the village under the night.
Drift towards the old wooden house.
Drift towards the open field.
Drift towards the village ruins.
Drift towards the abandoned mill.

lines.zh: 提着一盏灯笼走过田埂。
lines.en: She crosses the field ridge with a lantern.

lines.zh: 踩着木屐，悄悄绕向村口。
lines.en: Her sandals click softly toward the village gate.

lines.zh: 在这荒凉之地静静漂浮。
lines.en: Hover quietly in this desolate place.
Hover quietly in these ruins.
Wander here, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 在这破旧的木屋外飘荡。
lines.en: Drift outside the old wooden house.
Prowl in these ruins.
Drift in the village ruins.

lines.zh: 在这荒废的磨坊外飘荡。
lines.en: Drift outside the abandoned mill.

lines.zh: 在这破旧的教堂里飘荡。
lines.en: Drift in the old church.

lines.zh: 在这破败的村庄里飘荡。
lines.en: Drift in this decayed village.

lines.zh: 在这废弃的矿井上方飘荡。
lines.en: Drift above the abandoned mine.
Found you, ready to attack!
Found you, ready to fight.
You're close, ready to attack!
Targeted you, ready to act.

lines.zh: 我歪头，确认你不是村里人。
lines.en: I tilt my head to be sure you are not from the village.
Found you, ready to fight.
Noticed you, ready to attack.
Targeted you, ready to attack.
She tilts her head, checking if you're a demon.
She hides her blade behind her back.
I'm hurt...
My wings...

lines.zh: 握刀的手臂抬不起来了。
lines.en: My sword arm will not rise.

lines.zh: 腿被划开了，我站不住了。
lines.en: My leg is cut open, I can't stay standing.
I'm scared...
I'm tired...

lines.zh: 草鞋磨破了，脚底全是血。
lines.en: My straw sandal wore through, my sole bleeding.
I'm hungry...
I'm sleepy...
I'm sick...

lines.zh: 听到烤肉香气，你忍不住靠近。
lines.en: Can't resist the smell of roasting meat.

lines.zh: 看到村民准备食物，你偷偷接近。
lines.en: Creep close to villagers preparing food.

lines.zh: 你悄悄跟在村民身后，寻找机会。
lines.en: Follow villagers to find an opportunity.

lines.zh: 夜晚来临，你开始在村边游荡。
lines.en: Wander around the village at night.

lines.zh: 闻到食物香味，你忍不住靠近。
lines.en: Can't stay away from the food smell.

lines.zh: 村民的篝火让你感到温暖。
lines.en: Campfire gives you a sense of warmth.

lines.zh: 你试图靠近篝火，吸引注意。
lines.en: Try to approach the campfire to attract attention.

lines.zh: 你悄悄靠近，寻找可利用机会。
lines.en: Creep close to find an opportunity.

lines.zh: 听到村民谈论食物，你心动了。
lines.en: Food talk makes you crave.

lines.zh: 你悄悄观察，寻找进入村庄的机会。
lines.en: Watch villagers to find an entry point.

lines.zh: 你撞上了试图逃跑的村民。
lines.en: Collide with fleeing villagers.
Villagers try to avoid you.

lines.zh: 你无意中撞上了一名村民。
lines.en: Accidentally bump into a villager.

lines.zh: 村民试图摆脱你的纠缠。
lines.en: Villagers try to get away from you.

lines.zh: 你撞翻了一名试图逃跑的村民。
lines.en: You knock down a fleeing villager.

lines.zh: 村民试图躲避你的攻击。
lines.en: Villager tries to dodge your attack.

lines.zh: 你试图用撞击阻止村民逃跑。
lines.en: You try to stop villagers from escaping by colliding.

lines.zh: 村民试图推开你，保护自己。
lines.en: Villager tries to push you away.

lines.zh: 村民试图躲避你的撞击。
lines.en: Villager tries to avoid your collision.

lines.zh: 她扶住你，怕你摔进沟里。
lines.en: She steadies you so you don't fall in the ditch.
Meet another Undead girl.
Undead girls are attracted to each other.

lines.zh: 你试图与另一名Undead少女互动。
lines.en: Try to interact with another Undead girl.

lines.zh: Undead少女在村庄中寻找同伴。
lines.en: Undead girls search for companions in the village.

lines.zh: 你与另一名Undead少女建立了联系。
lines.en: Form a connection with another Undead girl.

lines.zh: Undead少女彼此交流，寻找盟友。
lines.en: Undead girls communicate to find allies.

lines.zh: 你试图吸引另一名Undead少女注意。
lines.en: Try to attract another Undead girl's attention.
Undead girls gather together.

lines.zh: 你与另一名Undead少女成为了朋友。
lines.en: Become friends with another Undead girl.

lines.zh: Undead少女们在村庄中寻找同伴。
lines.en: Undead girls search for companions in the village.
Found my staff!
Guardian of the village!
This is my place!
Run, the wraiths are here!
Protect the village, I can’t die!
Wraiths, taste my sword!
We belong here!
Wraiths, you can’t escape!
I’m Yachan, the village’s child!
Use my power to protect the village!
I sense your presence!

lines.zh: 再走一步，就进我的刀围。
lines.en: One more step and you enter my blade's reach.
I wait by the well for you to circle back.

lines.zh: 你的角露在斗笠外面了。
lines.en: Your horns show above your hat.

lines.zh: 村里的人都躲了，你们逃不掉。
lines.en: The villagers hid; you will not escape.
Beware, wraiths are here!

lines.zh: 村里的姑娘，也拿得动刀。
lines.en: A village girl can hold a blade too.
I’m the village’s protector!
Your doom is here!
Wraiths, your end!
Your teeth are too sharp.
Demons don't dare show by day.
I smell blood on you.
Don't walk toward the village.
I know those stripes.
Feel my blade!

lines.zh: 我只是村里的女孩，别伤我。
lines.en: I am only a village girl, do not hurt me.
I barred the village gate long ago.
This is my fight!

lines.zh: 村口那口井，我绕得过去。
lines.en: I can get around the well at the village gate.
I fight for justice!
You all can’t escape!
I’m protecting the village!

lines.zh: 你们都逃不掉我的攻击！
lines.en: You can’t escape my attacks!

lines.zh: 父亲教的站姿，今晚用上了。
lines.en: The stance my father taught me, used tonight.
You only lunge to the left.
One more step and I call for help.

lines.zh: 村口那口井我能绕过去。
lines.en: I can get around the village well.
My grip on the knife is steady.
Don't take me for a village girl.
My father taught me how to stand.
You've backed into the sunlight.

lines.zh: 我飘在半空，你抬不起刀。
lines.en: I float overhead; you cannot raise that blade.
I strike before your claw lifts.
I only need to hold this door.

lines.zh: 手持长剑冲向恶鬼，口中发出哀嚎。
lines.en: Rush at the evil with a sword, wailing loudly.

lines.zh: 挥舞着镰刀攻击恶鬼，发出刺耳尖叫。
lines.en: Swing the scythe at the evil, emitting a piercing scream.

lines.zh: 从村民家偷来盾牌，对着恶鬼狠狠挥击。
lines.en: Steal a shield from a villager and strike the evil hard.

lines.zh: 举起破碎的木剑，嘶吼着向恶鬼扑去。
lines.en: Raise a broken wooden sword and lunge at the evil, snarling.

lines.zh: 咬紧牙关，用双手握着小刀向恶鬼刺去。
lines.en: Gritting her teeth, stab the evil with both hands holding a small knife.

lines.zh: 用腐烂的长矛攻击恶鬼，发出痛苦的呻吟。
lines.en: Attack the evil with a rotten spear, groaning in pain.

lines.zh: 挥舞着燃烧的木棒，对恶鬼进行猛烈攻击。
lines.en: Swing a burning stick at the evil with great force.

lines.zh: 从地上捡起尖刺，向恶鬼乱刺。
lines.en: Grasp the sharp stake and stab the evil wildly.

lines.zh: 用沾满毒液的匕首刺向恶鬼的心脏。
lines.en: Stab the evil's heart with a poisonous dagger.

lines.zh: 手持镰刀，向恶鬼扑去，发出低沉的嘶吼。
lines.en: Rush at the evil with a scythe, emitting a low growl.
A kitchen knife can cut a demon!
That one's for the village chief!
I go for your wrist!
The wood axe from the kitchen will do.
This is for the child next door.
Keep off our doorstep.
You feel pain too, don't you?
I've practiced this swing for three years.

lines.zh: 我从村民家的地下室中爬出。
lines.en: I crawl out of the basement of a villager's house.

lines.zh: 我从远处的树林中慢慢出现。
lines.en: I slowly emerge from the distant forest.

lines.zh: 我从废弃的村庄边缘悄悄现身。
lines.en: I silently appear from the edge of a deserted village.

lines.zh: 我从附近的坟墓中缓缓升起。
lines.en: I slowly rise from a nearby grave.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗的洞穴中缓缓走出。
lines.en: I slowly emerge from a dark洞穴.

lines.zh: 我从村边的小河中爬出。
lines.en: I crawl out from the village stream.

lines.zh: 我从远处的废墟中慢慢现身。
lines.en: I slowly emerge from the ruins in the distance.

lines.zh: 我从一座倒塌的建筑物中走出。
lines.en: I walk out from a collapsed building.

lines.zh: 我从一片荒废的田野中现身。
lines.en: I appear from a desolate field.

lines.zh: 我从一片荒废的果园中走出。
lines.en: I walk out from a desolate orchard.
The lantern's lit. I stand guard here.
Tonight it's my turn to patrol.
The dogs barked, so I came out.
The rice isn't even harvested yet.

lines.zh: 我只是个村子里的女孩，救命。
lines.en: I'm only a village girl; help me.

lines.zh: 从屋顶滑下来，膝盖磕破了。
lines.en: I slid off the roof and skinned my knee.
River water fills my sleeves. So heavy.
Explosion hurt me.
An arrow came and my shoulder burned.
Potion splashed my arm like fire.
The village is gone. The hunger isn't.

lines.zh: 村子里的姑娘，哪见过这样的雷。
lines.en: A village girl has never seen such a bolt.
I'm lost in the void.
